title: ChaseTransaction
description: Represents a single Chase transaction exported to BigQuery for spending analysis. Source-agnostic by design: Chase exports checking-account and credit-card activity in the same shape (date, amount, description, category), so a single schema carries both feeds. Credit-card *balances* (APR, minimum payment, outstanding balance) are self-reported and live in LiabilitiesSnapshot instead — a transaction feed shows payments happening, not the debt behind them. If Spending Analysis ever needs to slice card vs. debit, or attribute spend to a specific card (e.g. rewards optimization), the lighter move is an optional `account_type` / `source_account` field here rather than a parallel schema. Deferred until a use case demands it.

user_id.description: The unique identifier of the user who owns this transaction.

amount.description: The transaction amount. Negative values indicate expenses/outflows.

description.description: The raw description of the transaction from the bank statement.

raw_category.description: The category provided by Chase before normalization.

normalized_category.description: The category after normalization into our standard taxonomy.
